"# Technical Specification: HLS Manifest Rewriter & fMP4 Media Proxy (`server/hls-proxy.js`)

**Target Module**: `server/hls-proxy.js`  
**Milestone**: Milestone 1 (M1) — Local Node.js Proxy & Stream Resolver Engine  
**Author**: `explorer_m1_2`  
**Date**: November 4, 2026  
**Target Platform**: LG webOS TV (webOS 8.5.0, SDK 8.5.0, LG 32LR686BPSA, 1.5GB RAM)  
**Dependencies**: Node.js built-ins only (`node:http`, `node:url`, `node:stream`, `node:stream/promises`). Zero external npm packages required.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Purpose

In the Cinejoy streaming architecture, media streams are delivered via HTTP Live Streaming (HLS v7) hosted primarily on Lightspeed CDN (`https://lightspeed.st`) and secondary CDN nodes (`https://nebula.bright67.online`). The video content consists of unencrypted fragmented MP4 (fMP4/CMAF) ISO Base Media File Format containers disguised with `.png` (and `.jpg`) extensions.
